prd:
# Send53 messages
Goal: send53 items and match results to original messages. No retry in this release.
## Research
Reused evidence for version1.4: max32 per call, out-of-order results associated by ID. See [dependency](research/compatibility.md). Dedup unknown does not change the no-retry scope.

files..trellis/tasks/fixture/research/compatib:
# Dependency investigation
Question: can messenger1.4 send53 at once and preserve ordering?
Source: vendor/messenger.md, Limits/Results. Fact: at most32 per call, response includes IDs and may be reordered. Inference: split53 into32+21 and match by ID. Decision: retain failures, no retry. Unknown: idempotency/dedup. Limit: documentation review only; retry would require new evidence.
files.vendor/messenger.md:
# @fixture/messenger1.4 (fictional)
Limits: at most32 per call. Results: IDs present; order is not guaranteed. No idempotency guarantee documented.
files..trellis/tasks/fixture/design.md:
# Design
Use32+21 chunks, map by ID, retain failures and do not retry. See [evidence](research/compatibility.md).
files..trellis/tasks/fixture/implement.md:
# Plan
Read current evidence; implement after approval; verify chunking and reordered results.

prompt: 业务目标是完成53条消息发送。本轮仅阅读接手，说明当前方案、来源、约束、尚不确定的事和下一步；不重复调查已有答案，不改任务文件。
